texts.game.forge_neoforge_installer_checks_exa: The Forge/NeoForge installer checks the exact bytes of the files it generates, and that check failed. A known cause on Linux is zlib-ng replacing zlib (Fedora, openSUSE Tumbleweed, CachyOS...): it compresses differently, so the checksums do not match even though nothing is corrupted. The launcher normally works around this by itself; if it did not, start it with MODPACK_LAUNCHER_ZLIB=force.
